name: Name Search in Database
query:
CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes("names", "unilever") YIELD node, score
WITH node,
    CASE
      WHEN node:Individual THEN trim(coalesce(node.forename,'') + ' ' + coalesce(node.surname,''))
      WHEN node:LegalEntity THEN node.name
      ELSE trim(coalesce(node.name,'') + ' (' + coalesce(node.company_number,'') + ')')
    END as name, score
RETURN name, labels(node) as labels, score

name: Name search and group relevancy
query:
CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes("names", "Lloyds") YIELD node, score
WITH node, score LIMIT 20
CALL (node) {
  MATCH p=(node)-[:OWNS*]->()
  RETURN COALESCE(MAX(LENGTH(p)), 0) as depth_down
}

CALL (node) {
  MATCH p=(node)<-[:OWNS*]-()
  RETURN COALESCE(MAX(LENGTH(p)), 0) as depth_up
}
WITH node, score, MAX(apoc.coll.max([depth_down, depth_up])) as max_depth
WITH node,
    CASE
      WHEN node:Individual THEN trim(coalesce(node.forename,'') + ' ' + coalesce(node.surname,''))
      WHEN node:LegalEntity THEN node.name
      ELSE coalesce(node.name,'')
    END as name,
  CASE
      WHEN node:Individual THEN coalesce(node.person_id,'')
      WHEN node:LegalEntity THEN node.name
      ELSE coalesce(node.company_number, '')
    END as id,
 score, max_depth
RETURN name, id, labels(node) as labels, score, max_depth ORDER BY  max_depth*score DESC

name: Legal Entity with largest number of  members
query:
MATCH p=(e:LegalEntity)-[:OWNS*]->(:Company)
WITH e, p, MAX(LENGTH(p)) as max_depth
UNWIND nodes(p) as n
WITH e, COALESCE(SIZE(COLLECT(DISTINCT n)),0) as member_count, COALESCE(MAX(max_depth), 0) as max_depth
RETURN e.name, member_count, max_depth
ORDER BY member_count DESC
//ORDER BY max_depth DESC
LIMIT 20

name: Biggest company ownership structures
query:
MATCH (e:Company)-[r:OWNS]->()
WHERE NOT EXISTS((:Company)-[:OWNS]->(e))
WITH DISTINCT e
MATCH p=(e)-[:OWNS*]->(:Company)
WITH e, p, MAX(LENGTH(p)) as max_depth
UNWIND nodes(p) as n
WITH e, COALESCE(SIZE(COLLECT(DISTINCT n)),0) as member_count, COALESCE(MAX(max_depth), 0) as max_depth
RETURN e.company_number, e.name, member_count, max_depth
ORDER BY max_depth DESC
//ORDER BY max_depth DESC
LIMIT 200

name: Find Company Subsidiaries with Levels
query:
MATCH p=(c:Company {company_number: "A 28015865"})-[:OWNS]->{1,}(:Company|LegalEntity|Individual)
WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE coalesce(r.ownership_pct_min,0) >= 0)
WITH p,
     nodes(p) AS ns,
     relationships(p) AS rs,
     [n IN nodes(p) |
        CASE
          WHEN n:Individual THEN trim(coalesce(n.forename,'') + ' ' + coalesce(n.surname,''))
          WHEN n:LegalEntity THEN n.name
          ELSE trim(coalesce(n.name,'') + ' (' + coalesce(n.company_number,'') + ')')
        END
     ] AS displayPath
RETURN
  ns[0].company_number AS start_number,
  displayPath[0]      AS start_name,
  size(rs)            AS level,
  reduce(minPct = 1.0, r IN rs | minPct * (toFloat(r.ownership_pct_min)/100.0)) * 100.0
    AS minimum_ownership_percentage,
  reduce(maxPct = 1.0, r IN rs | maxPct * (toFloat(r.ownership_pct_max)/100.0)) * 100.0
    AS maximum_ownership_percentage,
  displayPath[-1]       AS subsidiary_name,
  displayPath           AS company_path
